purpose: Recover raw Android IMU timing only when elapsedRealtimeNanos is absent but a raw-GNSS hardware-GPS-to-UTC affine witness is physically consistent; then run the already frozen Phase14 E1 leveling candidate.

base_and_immutable_recipe.phase14_recipe: Galileo E1 only, causal Hatch-30, maximum arc gap 1.5 s, reset on ADR/LLI/loss/clock count change, no new graph state

archive_and_route.structural_smoke_role: exact phone unused in positive truth inventory, but route overlaps prior pixel5 truth; no truth score permitted

raw_timing_audit.arrival_time_nanos_since_gps_epoch: observed but enriched/derived and forbidden as an inference input
raw_timing_audit.physical_interpretation: Raw GNSS TimeNanos-FullBiasNanos is GPS hardware time; utcTimeMillis is Unix UTC wall time; the affine fit is a raw-clock consistency witness. IMU utcTimeMillis can be mapped to GPST only in this explicit fallback and only under the fixed gates below.

utc_fallback_contract.mapping: Fit GPS_nanos = intercept + slope * utcTimeMillis from unique raw GNSS epochs using TimeNanos-FullBiasNanos-BiasNanos; use the fitted affine only to map IMU utcTimeMillis into GPST.
utc_fallback_contract.hardware_clock_discontinuity: if the raw field is present, one constant count is required; any change fails closed
utc_fallback_contract.utc_monotonicity: GNSS and supported IMU utcTimeMillis must be non-negative and strictly increasing after per-stream unique selection
utc_fallback_contract.pairing_clock: utcTimeMillis converted to integer nanoseconds for accel/gyro pairing; original elapsedRealtimeNanos remains absent (-1) and is never fabricated
utc_fallback_contract.failure: missing mapping, insufficient anchors, gap/drift/residual/count/monotonicity violation, mixed elapsed/blank rows, nonfinite mapped GPST, or pair bound violation fails closed

evaluation_protocol.mi8: truth-free structural smoke only; no score because route is not disjoint

gate_before_truth: Phase14 E1 counts and resets reported
